subject: general
question: Which year was declared as the ‘Year of Reforms’ by the Ministry of Defence of the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ministry of Defence, Government of India, declared the year **2025** as the "**Year of Reforms**" to bring transformative changes in the defense sector.
 
• This declaration aims to align the defense sector with modern needs, focusing on **self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat)** and enhancing operational efficiency.
 
• One of the primary goals is to implement reforms that boost **indigenous production** of defense equipment under the **Make in India** initiative.
 
• The Ministry is also working towards improving the **ease of doing business** in the defense sector by simplifying procurement processes and enhancing transparency.
 
• Several reforms under the "**Year of Reforms**" initiative include upgrading defense manufacturing capabilities, increasing private sector participation, and modernizing the armed forces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat in Defense:**

 
 
• The **Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan** (Self-Reliant India campaign) was launched by the Government of India in **2020** to promote self-reliance in various sectors, including defense.
 
• It focuses on reducing reliance on imports and enhancing indigenous defense manufacturing capabilities.
 
• Key initiatives include the **Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020**, which prioritizes indigenous procurement.
 
 
 
• **Make in India in Defense:**
 
 
• The **Make in India** initiative, launched in **2014**, aims to develop India as a global manufacturing hub, including in the defense sector.
 
• The government has introduced several policy measures to encourage domestic production, such as the **Strategic Partnership Model**.
 
• Examples include the production of **Tejas Light Combat Aircraft (LCA)** and other indigenous defense equipment.
 
 
 
• **Modernization of Armed Forces:**
 
 
• The Ministry of Defence has been focusing on modernizing the armed forces to enhance operational readiness and combat capability.
 
• Modernization plans include procurement of advanced fighter jets, submarines, and artillery systems.
 
• Efforts are being made to ensure the armed forces are equipped with state-of-the-art technology and equipment.
 
 
 
• **Defence Procurement Policy:**
 
 
• The **Defence Procurement Policy (DPP)**, now known as the **Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP)**, is a key framework for procurement in the defense sector.
 
• DAP 2020 emphasizes **indigenization**, encourages private sector participation, and aims to reduce procurement timelines.
 
• It also includes measures to boost research and development in defense technology.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Defense Exports:**

 
 
• The Government of India has set an ambitious target to achieve **defense exports worth $5 billion** by 2025 as part of its self-reliance goals.
 
• India is promoting indigenous defense products such as the **BrahMos missile system** and **Akash surface-to-air missiles** in the global market.
 
 
 
• **Defense Corridors:**
 
 
• The government has established two dedicated **defense corridors** in **Uttar Pradesh** and **Tamil Nadu** to boost indigenous production and attract investment.
 
• These corridors aim to create a robust defense manufacturing ecosystem and generate employment opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Innovation for Defence Excellence (iDEX):**
 
 
• The **iDEX initiative** was launched to foster innovation and technology development in the defense sector.
 
• It encourages startups and MSMEs to develop solutions for defense and aerospace challenges.
 
• iDEX has significantly contributed to the development of cutting-edge technologies for the Indian armed forces.
